[P2] Preserve the advertised AI errors across the step boundary

The core step handler reconstructs failures through `DurableOperationError.fromErrorObject`, returning `StepError` even on initial execution. Consequently, callers cannot catch the exported AI error classes, and `status`/`stopReason` are lost. Decider operations have the same problem. The missing-SDK tests bypass this boundary by replacing `context.step` with a direct function call. Preserve the error metadata in checkpoints and restore the advertised classes at each operation boundary, with runner-based tests for execution and replay.
